skills.name: fe-core
skills.description: Core conventions for consuming the ForEveryone Berlin design system. Use when importing CSS variables, resolving tokens, choosing fe-* classes, or deciding whether a colour or font is allowed.
skills.guide: Use the shared CSS, approved colours, typography, and brand rules.

skills.name: fe-design-system
skills.description: Route ForEveryone UI work to the design-system sources and the matching consumer skill. Use when asked to use the ForEveryone design system, invoke fe-design-system, or locate brand rules, tokens, component contracts, and integration guidance.
skills.guide: Find the maintained sources and choose the skill for the task.

skills.name: photo-curator
skills.description: Review photo collections and select ranked shortlists only in the ForEveryone design-system and foreveryone repositories. Use there for photo selection, placeholder replacement, atmosphere matching, or comparing similar photographs.
skills.guide: Select photographs for a brief, with ranked shortlists, placements, crops, and consent checks.

skills.name: fe-a11y
skills.description: Accessibility rules for ForEveryone Berlin UI. Use when checking contrast, keyboard focus, skip links, motion preferences, alt text, or WCAG 2.1 AA conformance.
skills.guide: Check contrast, keyboard focus, motion, and alternative text.

skills.name: fe-component-authoring
skills.description: Author a public fe-* component in this repository. Use when adding a component contract, its CSS, and its states.
skills.guide: Add a public component contract, its CSS, and its states.

skills.name: fe-components
skills.description: Prefer documented fe-* component contracts for ForEveryone Berlin UI. Use when building or restyling buttons, cards, inputs, tags, FAQ, header, footer, or related patterns.
skills.guide: Build components from documented markup and state contracts.

skills.name: fe-og-image
skills.description: Create on-brand ForEveryone OG images and featured-image artwork. Use for social link previews, WordPress featured images, or reusable image templates with verified copy, brand assets and export quality.
skills.guide: Create OG and featured images for a specific page.

skills.name: fe-redesign
skills.description: Restyle an existing web app to the ForEveryone Berlin design system. Use when replacing ad-hoc colours, fonts, and components with tokens and fe-* contracts from this repo.
skills.guide: Map an existing interface onto the design system.

skills.name: fe-token-authoring
skills.description: Author ForEveryone design tokens in this repository. Use when adding, changing, or removing a token and regenerating CSS variables.
skills.guide: Add or change a design token and regenerate the CSS variables.

skills.name: fe-tokens
skills.description: Resolve and apply ForEveryone Berlin design tokens. Use when mapping colours, type, spacing, radius, shadow, or motion to CSS variables, or when extending a palette in OKLCH.
skills.guide: Resolve token names and extend the palette by role.
